name: conversations_list
description: Lists all channels in a Slack team; supports Slack's types mix and exclude_archived filters, which need more than column-equality (GET /conversations.list)

types.description: Mix and match channel types by providing a comma-separated list of any combination of public_channel, private_channel, mpim. Default: public_channel.

exclude_archived.description: Set to true to exclude archived channels from the list. Default: false.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return. Default: 100.
